claims.disproof_condition: 條件：中國撤銷或放寬鎢相關出口管制，或 APT 價格回落到 2025 年 2 月水準附近；或鑽針廠一手寫出原料成本已轉嫁不了、毛利率下滑。核查頻率：每月（APT 報價與商務部公告）＋每季（鑽針廠財報毛利率）。觸發後 48 小時：重讀鑽針層讀圖的上游與定價段。
claims.statement: Third-party report (TrendForce citing Nikkei, 2026-11-09): China's tungsten export restrictions hit refiners in Japan, Taiwan, the U.S. and Europe and sent micro drill bit prices up severalfold; China produced about 79% of global tungsten in 2025 (USGS); the APT benchmark rose from about RMB 212,750 per ton in February 2025 to more than RMB 530,000. The price rise is raw-material cost push, not evidence by itself that drill makers hold pricing power.

claims.disproof_condition: 條件：鼎泰或中鎢高新的定期報告寫出擴產延後、產能利用率不足以支撐新增產能、或市占下滑。核查頻率：每季。觸發後 48 小時：改寫鑽針層讀圖「供給多快補上」那一段。
claims.statement: Third-party report (TrendForce citing Nikkei and China Nonferrous Metals News): Chinese drill makers Guangdong Dtech and Shenzhen Jinzhou Precision (a China Tungsten High-Tech subsidiary) have gained market share thanks to cheaper tungsten; Jinzhou has launched six capacity expansion projects since 2025, expected to add nearly 800 million micro drill bits of capacity. Supply-side counter-evidence to a durable drill-bit bottleneck.

sources.quote: [News] China’s Tungsten Export Curbs Send AI PCB Drill Bit Prices Soaring; Nearly 80% Global Output Share Highlights Supply Risks

China’s export restrictions on critical metals are disrupting supplies of micro drill bits. According to Nikkei , restrictions on tungsten have affected refiners in Japan, Taiwan, the U.S. and Europe, sending drill bit prices soaring severalfold.
China accounted for approximately 79% of global tungsten production in 2025, according to the U.S. Geological Survey, as noted by Nikkei.

Meanwhile, Chinese manufacturers, including Guangdong Dtech Technology and Shenzhen Jinzhou Precision Technology, have gained market share, benefiting from access to cheaper tungsten supplies, Nikkei notes.

Shenzhen Jinzhou Precision Technology, a subsidiary of China Tungsten High-Tech, has launched six capacity expansion projects since 2025, expected to add nearly 800 million micro drill bits in capacity.

prices of ammonium paratungstate (APT), an intermediate tungsten product and key pricing benchmark, have surged from around RMB 212,750 (US$31,900) per metric ton in February 2025 to more than RMB 530,000 as of the week of the report.
